crossRefs.note: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge…
But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the…

translations.web: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
translations.bsb: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
translations.kjv: I have ➔ not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
translations.asv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
